Name: Simple Flower Mead
Author: zombifier
Description:
This mod does what it says on the tin - flower honey now becomes flower-flavored mead instead of generic mead when put in the Keg. The formula is (honey price x 1.5) + 150.

Why use this instead of...
[list]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5767]Flower Mead[/url]﻿?
[list]
[*]You want something that works for the latest SDV (Flower Mead is currently broken on 1.6).
[/list][*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/22848]Better Honey Mead[/url]﻿?
[list]
[*]You want something even simpler than Better Honey Mead (Simple Flower Mead needs only Content Patcher and has no C# component, meaning it will likely keep working indefinitely even if the game updates)
[*]You want to keep the original honey and mead sprite since you have an item retexture (Better Honey Mead uses its own colored sprite for honey and mead, which not every retexture supports)
[/list][/list]

To install this mod, simple unzips into the Mods folder as usual.

NOTE:
[list]
[*]If you had [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/22256?tab=description]Extra Machine Config[/url]'s Flavored Mead addon, it is highly recommended you remove that one before installing this mod, though keeping both on the same machine shouldn't have adverse effects.
[*]Obviously don't use this if you already have Better Honey Mead.
[/list]

Manifest.Name: Simple Flower Mead
Manifest.Description: Allows honey to be turned into flavored meads.
